name: ai-limits
title: AI Limits
description: See usage limits, reset times and credits for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and AI API keys.
author: o101k

preferences.name: displayMode
preferences.title: Show Limits As
preferences.description: Show how much of each limit is used, or how much is left

preferences.name: showNotConnected
preferences.title: Providers
preferences.label: Show providers that aren't connected
preferences.description: List providers with no credentials found, with a Connect action for each

preferences.name: claudeSessionKey
preferences.title: Claude Session Key
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect Claude Code instead. A claude.ai sessionKey cookie, used when Claude Code isn't signed in on this Mac

preferences.name: cursorCookie
preferences.title: Cursor Session Cookie
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect Cursor instead. The WorkosCursorSessionToken cookie from cursor.com, used when the Cursor app isn't signed in on this Mac

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token for Copilot
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect GitHub on the Copilot item instead. A GitHub token, for example from `gh auth token`

preferences.name: openrouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect OpenRouter instead. An OpenRouter API key, to show its credit balance and spending limit

preferences.name: zaiApiKey
preferences.title: z.ai API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect z.ai instead. A GLM Coding Plan API key

preferences.name: zaiRegion
preferences.title: z.ai Region
preferences.description: Where your z.ai key was issued

preferences.name: kimiApiKey
preferences.title: Kimi Code API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect Kimi Code instead. A Kimi Code (coding plan) API key

preferences.name: deepseekApiKey
preferences.title: DeepSeek API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect DeepSeek instead. A DeepSeek API key, to show its balance

preferences.name: moonshotApiKey
preferences.title: Moonshot API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Choose Connect Moonshot instead. A Moonshot (Kimi API platform) key, to show its balance

preferences.name: moonshotRegion
preferences.title: Moonshot Region
preferences.description: Where your Moonshot key was issued

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Show AI Usage
commands.description: See usage limits, reset times and credits for your AI tools and API keys

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
